title: Data and recovery
description: Your saved data stays on this iPhone. Export a backup to keep a copy somewhere else.
crashMessage: Try opening the app again. You can also save a copy of your data or restore a backup below.
savedFileDescription: Exports the file as stored, even if it cannot be opened. An unreadable file may need repair before it can be restored.
noSavedFile: There is no saved data file to export.
checkpointDescription: The three most recent copies saved before restoring a backup or recovery copy. These copies are on this iPhone and are deleted when you clear travel data or reset the app.
restoreCheckpointMessage: Replaces your data and settings with the copy saved %{date}. Changes made since then will be replaced. Your current saved file will be kept as a recovery copy.
restored: Data restored. You can open the app again.
resetComplete: The app has been reset. You can open it again to start fresh.
diagnosticsDescription: Includes app versions and recent error codes. Does not include your places, location, or list names. You choose where to share it.
nativeInstructions: Open iPhone Settings → Apps → PastPins and turn on Reset on Next Launch. Close PastPins from the app switcher, then reopen it. This erases local data and recovery copies. Exported backups and iOS permissions stay.
nativeUnavailable: The iPhone Settings reset is available in a PastPins development or App Store build, not Expo Go.
nativeResetWarning: Erases all PastPins data, settings, and recovery copies when the app next starts. Backups saved outside the app and iOS permissions stay. Close PastPins from the app switcher, then reopen it. Turn this off before reopening to cancel.

errors.invalid-document: This data could not be read. Your saved file has not been replaced. You can retry, export it for recovery, restore a backup, or reset the app.
errors.unsupported-version: This data was saved by a newer version of PastPins. Update the app to open it. Your saved file has not been changed.
errors.storage-read: Your saved data could not be accessed. Try again. If it still cannot be opened, you can restore a backup or reset the app.
errors.storage-write: Your changes could not be saved. Check the available storage on your iPhone and try again.
errors.reset-failed: The reset could not finish. To reset before the app opens, use Reset on Next Launch in iPhone Settings, close PastPins from the app switcher, then reopen it. If you are testing the app, make sure your development build is up to date.
